q-0334.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0381.answer:
Surah Al-Anbiyaa (21) — The Prophets · 112 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Your Lord, beside Whom there is no other god, is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and all that they contain; He is the One Who initiated their creation; He is the Creator of all things.
• I have already informed you that I have nothing to do with you and you have nothing to do with me.
• Speaking to your fathers whose actions you cite as evidence would be the same as speaking to you.
• I declare that I am in a state of war with you as you are in a state of war with me.
• I do not know, perhaps it is a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0536.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah As-Saff (61) — The Ranks · 14 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• None is more unjust than he who lies about Allah and calls upon rivals and associates partners with Him, even while he is being invited to Tawhid and sincerely worshipping Him.
• We will support you with regards to the Message you have been sent with and will help you convey it.
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
• Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.
